description: A night scene in a mud-brick village. In the foreground a bearded man in a loincloth-style tunic prods glowing stones in a pit fire with a long pole, while a second man at left pours water from a jug, sending up steam. A third figure carries a basket of pale stones, and a woman kneels at right beside a flat slab with white powder spread across the ground. There is no visible text, border or frame.
